integrity: Closed-form result with a proof by balanced connected Eulerian edge multiplicities; a separate reproducible Python checker performs finite independent enumeration but is not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Binary cyclic length-three contiguous-factor profiles only; profile multiplicities and more general alphabets/read lengths are not counted. Literature comparison is not exhaustive and independent scientific validation has not occurred.
title: Exact enumeration of cyclic binary trigram profiles
